## Shape Counts

```{r Count of Manhattan-ish Shapes}
#| code-summary: "Count Shapes"
#| code-fold: true

manhattan_territory_counts <- data.frame(
  type = c("ZIP Code Tabulation Areas", "Census Tracts", "Census Block Groups", "Census Blocks", "Grid: 0.01 x 0.01 Decimal", "Grid: 100 x 100 Meter"),
  count = c(
      nrow(zcta_manhattan),
      nrow(new_york_county_tracts),
      nrow(new_york_county_bg),
      nrow(new_york_county_blocks),
      nrow(manhattan_grid_decimal_01),
      nrow(manhattan_grid_meter_100)
    )
  )

datatable(manhattan_territory_counts, rownames = FALSE) %>%
  formatRound('count', digits = 0, mark = ",")
```
